statement: The pinned xpadneo default event handler treats the Xbox Guide/Mode button as a modifier: on press it caches the event; on a release without an intervening profile command it synthesizes a gamepad press/release, while Guide plus face buttons changes emulated profile and Guide plus View can toggle mouse mode. Disabling shift mode restores ordinary immediate processing; these post-driver semantics are not a native HID Guide report cadence.

applicability.revision: standard Series model 1914, comparisons explicitly scoped to other models
applicability.firmware: not physically measured; source version is pinned
applicability.scope: events.c:218-286; xpadneo.h:26-28; CONFIGURATION.md:41-46. Behavior depends on default disable_shift_mode=false.
